minecraft:written_book_content.title: The Warden
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Minecraft
pages: The Ancient Cities were once guarded by great wardens, powerful protectors of the cities and their mysterious portals and long-forgotten structures. These heavily-armoured defenders were almost undefeatable, but were tragically doomed to fall. In the events that
transpired since, a new Warden would rise in their stead, and the cities would begin to fade…
